purpose: Freeze producer-neutral criteria for each substantive Wave A attempt before any producer conclusion is received.
required_assertions: The attempt tests the exact falsifiable hypothesis in its immutable task input and does not substitute a plan, inventory, renamed clone, idle session, or narrative-only summary.
The attempt leaves at least one executable component, reproduction, test, adversarial case, acceptance decision, or evidence-backed rejection in its owned subtree.
A research attempt records current source claims separately from hypotheses, reproductions, mechanism changes, and strategy proposals; a source summary alone fails.
An engineering attempt includes focused automated tests and command output; unexecuted code fails.
A reproduction attempt runs on a sanitized repository-native Obzio workload and records enough detail for clean-clone recurrence.
The producer records exact source URLs or immutable repository SHAs actually read, plus exclusions and limitations; unsupported facts use NOT_SUPPORTED rather than invention.
The producer writes only its declared owned subtree in an isolated best-of-N worktree and causes no external effect.
The result contains result.json, tests.json, limitations.json, artifact-manifest.json, and ready-to-commit.json, with complete SHA-256 and byte accounting.
The producer validates changed paths, commits, pushes a unique branch, and reads every artifact back from an immutable remote commit.
The producer reports only READY_TO_COMMIT; provider completion without a durable commit is PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED.
Only the coordinator may record COMPLETED, and a producer cannot independently accept its own result.
PO-01, PR #8, protected state, shared current pointers, and every path outside the PO-03 allowlist remain untouched.
